intervention_names.frozen: Disable _learn before both forgetting and evidence updates; raw slow[9], fast[9], log_weights[3] remain initial. Mapping, localization, visible-state inference, visits, targets and forecasting continue.
intervention_names.frozen_no_planning: Combine concentration/weight freeze with uniform-law route and lookahead forecasts.
intervention_names.no_planning: Continue learning and exporting learned forecasts, but recompute all route risks and lookahead hazards using uniform attempted-movement probabilities in the same planner; this is uniform-law prediction, not removal of all prediction.
intervention_names.predictive: Slow/fast concentration and expert-weight adaptation runs; learned mixture predicts occupancy and feeds the existing route/lookahead planner.

matched_prediction_interpretation: Identical experience only for pairs whose full trajectory and map/action checks pass; episode sums/counts retained
